stem.en: A sound of 15 Hz is made in a room, as loudly as possible. Can the people in the room hear it?

text.en: No. It is infrasonic, below 20 Hz, so making it louder does not help.
No. It is ultrasonic, so only animals can hear it.
Yes, but very softly, because low sounds lose their energy quickly.
Yes, and it sounds very shrill.

explanation.en: Humans hear from about 20 Hz to 20 000 Hz. 15 Hz is below 20 Hz, so it is infrasonic. Whether a sound is infrasonic depends on its frequency, not on its loudness. An elephant could detect it.

hints.en: Compare 15 Hz with the bottom of the audible range, 20 Hz.
Does loudness change the frequency of a sound?
